privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect through {{siteDomain}} ("Site", "we") and for what purposes, along with your rights.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: The data controller under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK") is {{seller.name}} ({{seller.website}}). You can reach us at {{seller.email}} or via the Contact page. See the KVKK Information Notice for details.

sections.heading: 2. Data We Collect
sections.body: When you create an account we collect your username, email address, and password (stored encrypted). While using the site we may collect your favorite teams/leagues, comments and poll activity, credit balance, and technical data such as IP address and browser information. When you create an account, the campaign link that brought you to the site (utm source/medium/campaign) and the time that visit started are saved to your account. We use this information only to measure which of our promotional efforts work. Until you sign up, this information is kept only on your device for the duration of your browser session; no cookie is used for this and it is not shared with third parties. When you sign up, the date on which you accepted the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy and the version of the text you accepted are stored with your account. When you buy credits, the order record (order number, package, amount, date, status, payment provider transaction number) and the time of your pre-purchase approval and the version of the approved text are stored; an order summary is sent to your e-mail address.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Data
sections.body: We use collected data to create and manage your account, provide personalized content (favorites, AI analysis history), process credit/balance transactions, improve service quality and security, and comply with our legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies
sections.body: Strictly necessary cookies keep you signed in and secure; a functional cookie tracks the daily message allowance when the AI assistant is used without an account. Language, theme and favourite preferences are kept in browser storage, not cookies; page statistics are collected without cookies. You can manage cookies in your browser settings; if you block strictly necessary cookies you may not be able to sign in. Details of the cookies and browser storage we use are on the Cookie Policy page.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing With Third Parties
sections.body:
Apart from legal obligations, your personal data is shared only with the service providers below, to the extent needed to provide the service; they process it on our behalf and for the purposes we set. The table is based on the providers actually used in the site's code. Sentry error logs are stored on servers in the European Union (Germany); no session replay or performance monitoring is used.

On the payment result page, information the payment provider adds to the address (e.g. your e-mail address) is removed from the address as soon as the page opens and is not sent to page statistics or error logs. Some providers are established abroad or process data on servers abroad; these transfers are made under the conditions set out in KVKK Art. 9 and only to the extent needed to provide the service.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security and Retention
sections.body: Your data is retained for a period proportionate to its purpose and protected with reasonable technical and administrative safeguards. You can delete your account yourself at any time under Profile › My info › Delete account; you will be asked to type your email address or "SİL" to confirm, and a confirmation is sent to your email address afterwards. If you cannot sign in, you can also delete it from the Delete account page ({{siteDomain}}/hesap-silme) with a confirmation link sent to your email address. On deletion, your profile, sessions and Google connection, favourites, credit balance and credit history, unlocked analyses, notifications, likes and follows, poll votes and Frikik scores are deleted immediately. Your Gündem posts and comments are not deleted; the author information is removed and they stay published anonymously under the name "Deleted user". Payment and order records (amount, package, date, status, payment provider transaction id) are retained with the link to your account removed. Order records are kept for 10 years under the retention obligations of tax and commercial law (Tax Procedure Law, Turkish Commercial Code). Deleted data is removed from backups within the backup cycle, at the latest within 30 days.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
sections.body: Subject to applicable data protection law, you may have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request information about processing, learn the purpose of processing, know third parties your data is shared with, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion, and object to certain processing. You do not need to submit a request to delete your account and the data linked to it: Profile › My info › Delete account. You can submit other requests via the Contact page.

sections.heading: 8. Changes
sections.body: This policy may be updated from time to time; the current version is always published on this page.

terms.intro: By visiting or using {{siteDomain}}, you agree to the terms below. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: 1. Description of Service
sections.body: {{brand}} is an informational platform providing live match scores, standings, news, and AI-generated match analysis and prediction content.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts
sections.body: Some features (favorites, commenting, generating AI analyses, credit balance) require an account. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for activity under your account.

sections.heading: 3. AI Content and Disclaimer
sections.body: AI match analyses, score/outcome predictions, accuracy statistics, and betting-market commentary (including "Value Bet" labels) on this site are provided for informational and entertainment purposes only. They do not constitute investment advice, betting advice, or any guarantee; past accuracy does not guarantee future results. You are solely responsible for any decisions you make based on this content.

sections.heading: 4. Credit System
sections.body: AI match analyses are unlocked with credits; unlocking one analysis costs 1 credit. New members receive a one-time 2-credit signup bonus when they verify their email address. Accounts with a verified email that are at least 24 hours old can unlock one ready-made (already generated) analysis for free each week. Credit packages can be bought on the Pricing page; packages, prices, refund and withdrawal terms are on the Pre-Contract Information Form, Distance Sales Agreement and Refund & Cancellation pages. Credit system terms may be updated; the current terms are always on this page.

sections.heading: 5. User Conduct
sections.body: Posting abusive, harassing, unlawful, or spam content in comments or polls is prohibited. Content that violates these rules may be removed and the associated account may be suspended. In Gündem and other user content areas, content that breaks the Community Guidelines (insults, hate speech, threats, obscenity, spam, sharing personal data, illegal content) is prohibited; there is no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users. {{brand}} may hide or remove such content without prior notice, warn the user, suspend their ability to post in Gündem temporarily or permanently, and close the account for severe or repeated violations. An account closure can be appealed by writing to {{contactEmail}}. The data of a closed account is handled under the account deletion rules in the Privacy Policy. If the account holds purchased, unused credits at the time of closure, their price is refunded on request.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.body: The site design, logo, and original content belong to {{brand}}. Score and statistics data obtained from third-party providers remain subject to those providers' rights.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The site is provided "as is". We do not guarantee that match data, statistics, or AI outputs will always be accurate or up to date. To the maximum extent permitted by law, {{brand}} is not liable for direct or indirect damages arising from use of the site.

sections.heading: 8. Changes and Governing Law
sections.body: These terms may be updated from time to time. Disputes arising from these terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye.

kvkk.pageDesc: {{brand}} information notice on the processing of personal data (Turkish Law No. 6698, Art. 10).
kvkk.intro: This notice is provided under Article 10 of Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) to inform {{siteDomain}} users about how their personal data is processed.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: Data controller: {{seller.name}} · Website: {{seller.website}} · E-mail: {{seller.email}}

sections.heading: 2. Personal Data Processed
sections.body: Identity (name, username), contact (email address), account and transaction data (credit history, unlocked analyses, favourite teams/leagues, comments and posts), security data (IP address, session data, irreversible password hash, login attempts), signup source (campaign link utm data) and the signup consent record (date and text version). For purchases, the order record and the purchase approval record (time of approval and text version).

sections.heading: 3. Purposes
sections.body: Creating and managing member accounts, running AI analysis and credit operations, providing personalised content, keeping information and accounts secure, preventing abuse, measuring promotional campaigns and meeting legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Legal Grounds
sections.body: Creating and managing the account, AI analysis and credit operations and purchases are necessary to conclude and perform a contract (KVKK Art. 5/2-c). Order, payment and purchase consent records are processed to comply with a legal obligation (Art. 5/2-ç). Information and account security, abuse prevention, measuring promotional activity and improving the service rely on legitimate interest (Art. 5/2-f); records needed to protect rights in possible disputes are kept under Art. 5/2-e. No processing is based on explicit consent.

sections.heading: 5. Collection Method
sections.body: Personal data is collected electronically through signup and profile forms, Google sign-in, technical logs created while using the site and strictly necessary cookies.

sections.heading: 6. Transfers
sections.body: To provide the service, data is transferred to the service providers below only to the extent needed for that service (the table is based on the site's code). Recipient groups: hosting and database, e-mail delivery, error monitoring, bot protection, AI and payment service providers, and competent public authorities on request. Some providers are established abroad or process data on servers abroad; these transfers are made under the conditions set out in KVKK Art. 9.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
sections.body: Account data is kept until the account is deleted. Order and payment records are kept for 10 years under tax and commercial law, and transaction security records (IP address, sign-in attempts) for at most 2 years. Data whose period has expired is deleted or anonymized; removal from backups is completed within the backup cycle, at the latest within 30 days.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights and Requests
sections.body: To exercise your rights under KVKK Art. 11, you can send your request, in line with the Communiqué on Application Procedures to the Data Controller, from the e-mail address registered to your account to {{seller.email}}. Requests are concluded free of charge within 30 days at the latest. You can delete your account and the data linked to it yourself, without a request, under Profile › My info › Delete account; what is deleted and what is anonymized is described in section 6 of the Privacy Policy.

cookies.intro: This page explains the cookies and similar browser storage technologies used on {{siteDomain}}.

sections.heading: 1. Strictly Necessary Cookies
sections.body: Authentication cookies (session token, CSRF protection, post-login return address) are used for sign-in and security. Member features do not work without them.

sections.heading: 2. Functional Cookie
sections.body: If you message the AI assistant without an account, an oy_aid cookie containing a random identifier (HttpOnly, 1 year) is set to track the daily message allowance. It is only created when the assistant is used.

sections.heading: 3. Browser Storage
sections.body: Preferences such as language, theme and favourite teams/leagues are kept in your browser's storage (localStorage) and are not sent to our servers. The campaign info (utm) and start time of your first visit session are kept only for the browser session (sessionStorage) and saved to your account once if you sign up.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics and Error Monitoring
sections.body: Vercel Web Analytics is used for page view statistics; it does not use cookies. Technical errors are recorded with Sentry; no cookies, name or email are attached to error reports.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Services
sections.body: Cloudflare Turnstile is loaded on the signup page for bot protection; Cloudflare may use security identifiers on its side. Team and league logos are loaded from our data provider's servers. No advertising cookies are used.

sections.heading: 6. Cookie Preferences
sections.body: The site uses only strictly necessary and functional cookies needed for the service to work; no advertising or cookie-based analytics cookies are used, so no separate cookie consent is requested. If a non-essential cookie is added, your consent will be asked before it is used. You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings; if you block strictly necessary cookies you may not be able to sign in.

refund.pageDesc: {{brand}} refund and cancellation terms for credit packages.
refund.intro: These terms apply to AI analysis credit packages purchased on {{siteDomain}}.

sections.heading: 1. Seller
sections.body: Seller: {{seller.name}} · Website: {{seller.website}} · E-mail: {{seller.email}}

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body: These terms cover AI analysis credit packages to be purchased on {{siteDomain}}. Free entitlements such as the signup bonus and the weekly free analysis are not sales.

sections.heading: 3. Right of Withdrawal
sections.body: In distance contracts the consumer generally has a 14-day right of withdrawal. However, it cannot be exercised for services performed instantly in electronic form and intangible goods delivered instantly to the consumer (Distance Contracts Regulation Art. 15/1-ğ and h). Because credits are added to the account as soon as payment is confirmed, by ticking the box at the purchase step the Buyer agrees to immediate performance and accepts that the right of withdrawal ends.

sections.heading: 4. Refund of Unused Credits
sections.body: Because purchased credits are added to the account immediately, they are not covered by the right of withdrawal and unused credits are, as a rule, not refunded. Cases where the law requires a refund and the closure of the account by {{brand}} (Terms of Use, section 5) are reserved.

sections.heading: 5. Failed or Incomplete Transactions
sections.body: If payment was taken but the credits were not added, the same order was charged more than once, or the amount charged differs from the package price, write to {{seller.email}} with the order number. The request is reviewed within 3 business days at the latest: missing credits are added to the account; duplicate or excess charges are refunded through Hikie to the card used for payment within 14 days at the latest. How long the refund takes to appear on your card statement depends on your bank. Credits of an order refunded through Hikie are deducted from the account.

sections.heading: 6. Requests
sections.body: For refund and cancellation requests, write to {{seller.email}}.

preInfo.pageDesc: {{brand}} pre-contract information form for buying AI analysis credits.
preInfo.intro: This form contains the information to read and accept before placing an order and is accepted with the checkbox at the purchase step.

sections.heading: 1. Seller Details
sections.body: Seller: {{seller.name}} · Website: {{seller.website}} · E-mail: {{seller.email}}

sections.heading: 2. Main Characteristics of the Product
sections.body: AI analysis credits: 1 credit is the right to unlock one AI match analysis for your account; an unlocked analysis stays unlocked permanently. Credits do not expire. Packages are one-time purchases; there is no subscription, automatic renewal or recurring charge. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred to another account. AI match analyses are statistical predictions for information only; no outcome is guaranteed.

sections.heading: 3. Price and Additional Costs
sections.body: Prices are in Turkish lira and include VAT; there are no shipping or extra service fees. The price shown on the Pricing page at the time of the order applies. Current packages:

sections.heading: 4. Payment
sections.body: Payment is taken on the payment page provided by the Seller's payment service provider Hikie (hikie.space). Card details are entered only on Hikie's payment page; {{brand}} does not see, process or store the card number, expiry date or security code. From the payment result {{brand}} records only that the order was paid, the amount, the currency and Hikie's transaction number in the order record. If the payment is not completed or is declined, no credits are added to the account.

sections.heading: 5. Delivery
sections.body:
The product is digital; there is no physical delivery. Credits are added to the Buyer's account automatically and immediately once Hikie confirms the payment (signed payment notification); this usually takes a few seconds. An order summary (order number, package, credits, amount, date, seller details) is also sent to the account's e-mail address.

If payment was taken but the credits do not appear within a reasonable time, the Buyer can write to {{seller.email}} with the order number; the order record is checked and a paid order is credited to the account.

sections.heading: 6. Right of Withdrawal
sections.body:
In distance contracts the consumer generally has a 14-day right of withdrawal. However, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised for services performed instantly in electronic form, intangible goods delivered instantly to the consumer, and services whose performance starts with the consumer's approval before the withdrawal period ends (Distance Contracts Regulation art. 15/1-ğ and h). Because credits are added to the account as soon as payment is confirmed, by ticking the box at the purchase step the Buyer confirms that they agree to immediate performance and know that they therefore lose the right of withdrawal. This exception also applies to credits that have been added to the account but not yet used; performance is complete as soon as the credits are added.

For wrong or duplicate charges, the Refund and Cancellation Terms apply.

sections.heading: 7. Complaints and Remedies
sections.body: Complaints and requests can first be sent to {{seller.email}}. For disputes, the Buyer may apply to the Consumer Arbitration Committee at their place of residence or where the transaction was made within the monetary limit announced each year by the Ministry of Trade, and to the Consumer Court above that limit.

sections.heading: 8. Personal Data
sections.body: For the personal data processed during the order (account details, order record, time of approval and text version, payment result) and the service providers it is shared with, see the Privacy Policy and the KVKK Information Notice.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.body: E-mail: {{seller.email}} · Contact form: {{siteDomain}}/iletisim

sections.heading: 10. Confirmation
sections.body: By ticking the box at the purchase step you confirm that you received the information in this form, read the Distance Sales Contract and agree to the immediate performance of the digital content. The time of approval and the form version ({{legalEffectiveDate}}) are stored in the order record.

contact.intro: For questions, feedback, or data protection requests, you can reach us through the channel below.
contact.responseNote: We try to respond to requests as quickly as possible.

community.pageDesc: {{brand}} Gündem community guidelines: prohibited content, reporting, blocking and enforcement.
community.intro: These guidelines apply to posts, comments and public profile fields (name, username, bio) in Gündem. We want a respectful place to talk football. There is no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users.

sections.heading: 1. Prohibited content
sections.body: Profanity and insults; hate speech targeting race, ethnicity, religion, sect, gender, sexual orientation, disability or similar characteristics; threats, incitement to violence and encouraging self-harm; harassment, targeting and persistent unwanted contact; obscene or sexual content; sharing other people's personal data (address, phone, ID details, etc.) without permission; spam, advertising and harmful links; impersonation and deliberately misleading content; any illegal content.

sections.heading: 2. Automatic moderation
sections.body: Posts pass through an automatic filter before they are published. Text containing severe violations is not published; borderline content is published but queued for review. New accounts can add only a limited number of links per post, and posting the same content again within a short time is blocked. The filter can make mistakes; if you think you were blocked by mistake, write to us.

sections.heading: 3. Reporting
sections.body: Every post and comment has a “Report” option in its “⋯” menu; choose a reason and optionally add a short note. You need to be signed in to report, and you can report the same content once. The reporter's identity is never shown to the author. Content reported by several different users is hidden until the review is complete. We review reports within {{reviewHours}} hours at the latest.

sections.heading: 4. Blocking
sections.body: You can block a user from their profile or from the “⋯” menu of their post. Posts, comments and notifications from people you block are not shown to you; they cannot mention you or send you notifications; any follow between you is removed. The blocked person is not told that they were blocked. You can unblock from Profile › Blocked users.

sections.heading: 5. Enforcement
sections.body: Content that breaks these guidelines may be hidden or removed; the user may be warned, their ability to post in Gündem may be suspended temporarily or permanently (signing in and reading remain available), and the account may be closed for severe or repeated violations. Enforcement is applied in steps according to the severity of the violation: a warning, hiding or removing content, suspending posting rights and closing the account; the account may be closed directly for severe violations. Illegal content may be retained under Law No. 5651 and related legislation and shared with competent authorities on their request. See section 6 for appeals.

sections.heading: 6. Appeals and contact
sections.body: To appeal a decision, report content that was blocked by mistake or tell us about an urgent issue, write to {{contactEmail}}. If someone's safety is at risk, please contact the authorities (112) first.
